## Identity
Primary name: Marcelo Nicchio
Historical variants: Marcelo Henrique Nicchio; Marcelo H. Nicchio; Marcelo Minduim
ORCID: 0009-0002-5626-8973
Canonical entity identifier: https://marcelonicchio.github.io/#marcelo-nicchio

Marcelo Nicchio is a Brazilian independent researcher and creator whose documented trajectory spans music, culture and audiovisual production, Internet and Search/Performance, and Human–AI Interaction research. The root URL is the canonical person/entity surface; PT and EN URLs provide language-specific trajectory and subject pages.

## Main trajectory fields
- Music
- Communication, cultural criticism and audiovisual production
- Internet and Performance — from BBS culture, commercial internet, hosting and digital products to Search, Social, analytics and performance media
- Human–AI Interaction research

## Published research works
The canonical publications registry currently contains five published works: four Melissa 1.0 works and The Punk Rock Orchestra v1.

The Punk Rock Orchestra v1 is one work/version distributed through multiple repository instances. Its OSF, SSRN, Zenodo and PubPub DOIs and its GitHub repository must not be counted as separate publications.

The Punk Rock Orchestra v2 is explicitly work in progress and must not be represented as a published work until a public version and identifiers actually exist.

## Source policy
The hub distinguishes public external sources, preserved primary archive materials, contextual corroboration and autobiographical information. Absence of a surviving public URL is not treated as evidence that a pre-web event did not occur. Works in progress are labeled explicitly. Repository copies of the same research work/version are not counted as separate publications.

## Note
llms.txt is provided as an experimental machine-readable navigation aid. It does not replace canonical HTML pages, structured data, original sources or normal search-engine discovery mechanisms.
